verdict.rationale: Elicit's docs say every Research Agent session runs at an effort level set from a slider (Fastest, Fast, Balanced, Smart, Smartest) before the question is sent. Scope can be shaped up front through skills, advanced search filters such as journal and citation restrictions, and API-level control over a systematic review's search strategy and screening criteria. Iteration is described only after outputs are produced. Missing for 10: evidence of adjusting effort or scope while a run is in progress, an explicit depth or breadth control separate from effort level, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the effort slider.
